title: Travel Rule Config
description: Returns the travel rule compliance configuration for a specific country. This configuration defines the data collection requirements and processing rules that apply when sending transactions from that country. Use this to understand which fields you need to collect from your users before initiating a send transaction.

schema.default: ISO country code to retrieve the travel rule configuration for (e.g. NG, ZA, KE, US).

id.default: Unique identifier for this travel rule configuration.
